meta.title: The Seven (Plot LA-4, FB Area Blk 21, Karachi): road network in the WEB frame

frame.axes: three.js web/site frame used by src/data/site.json and the GLB assets: +X right, +Z front (main road side). Top view in the app draws +Z DOWN the screen.
frame.compound: unchanged: towers/boundary exactly as in public/models/seven/transform.json + site.json

registration.method: rigid (rotation+translation, scale 1) fit of the web plot boundary to the real plot: back edge -> 40-ft back street (OSM 549109386/388/382/390), left edge -> alley (OSM 549109399), arc -> Shahrah->Rashid Minhas slip (OSM 176085013), front straight -> Shahrah SB (OSM 176085028). Chirality: glTF/three.js top view is (x, -z) in a right-handed plan; the old rev2-4 maps used (x, +z) and were MIRRORED.
registration.web_to_enu: E = cos(t)*x + sin(t)*z + tx ;  N = sin(t)*x - cos(t)*z + ty   (t = theta)
registration.enu_to_web: x = cos(t)*(E-tx) + sin(t)*(N-ty) ;  z = sin(t)*(E-tx) - cos(t)*(N-ty)

residuals_m.arc: -5 (arc is the GLB design arc r=134.5 m; the real slip curb is r≈95 m, so the arc can never fit better than ~5-18 m)

registration.note: The GLB plot is ~19% larger than the official plot; near the compound the RENDER geometry (site.json offsets) is kept, the map supplies everything beyond ~60 m.

levels.1: +7.5 m deck (Rashid Minhas viaduct, cloverleaf loops, Lyari Expressway)
levels.2: +15 m (LEW link ramp over the Shahrah crossing)

elevation.shahrah_nala_bridge: +1.5 m hump (the nala is sunken ~5.5 m, the Shahrah crosses it on a near-grade bridge)
elevation.grades: ramps 5 % (bridge ways), approach links capped at 8 %; per-vertex y in centerline_xzy

conventions.centerline_xzy: [x, z, y] every ~4 m; one-way roads flow in polyline order

render_backdrop_variant.note: What the CAM02 render shows on the LEFT (-x, NE) side, unprojected with the solved CAM02 camera (pos (356.4,377.4,359.8), fov 31.1 deg, rms 5.9 px on 7 roof centres). The artist placed the nala, its far retaining wall and the expressway ~110-160 m further from the compound than they really are, and the LEW link flyover ~100 m further out. The right side (Rashid Minhas viaduct, loop SW) agrees with the map within ~10-50 m. Use these only if camera-matched CAM01/CAM02 views must line up; accuracy +-20-40 m.
